channel.title: Blocktape
channel.description: Blocktape reports crypto news: exchange and market moves, protocol upgrades, token launches, security incidents, regulation and enforcement across chains.

item.title: Five Steps to Recover a Stuck Cross-Chain Swap
item.description: A stuck cross-chain swap needs a chain-by-chain check: verify the source transaction, trace the bridge, then use the route’s documented recovery path.

item.title: What to Do When a Cross-Chain Transfer Gets Stuck
item.description: A stuck bridge transfer may be pending on the source chain, awaiting a destination action, or eligible for a refund; check its status before retrying.

item.title: How to Size Recurring Cross-Chain Treasury Transfers
item.description: Size recurring cross-chain transfers from destination cash needs, settlement delays and route costs, then set a buffer and review trigger to limit idle capital.

item.title: Set a Minimum Output for Destination Swaps
item.description: A destination swap floor sets the least output a cross-chain route can deliver; compare it with the quote, fees and failure path before signing for your chosen token.

item.title: How to Compare Two Routes for a Cross-Chain Swap
item.description: Compare cross-chain swap routes by destination amount, fees, timing and failure handling; the cheapest displayed quote may not deliver the best result.

item.title: Swap Into a Stablecoin Before Bridging to Limit Price Exposure
item.description: Swap into a stablecoin on the source chain before bridging when the route supports it; compare swap, bridge and gas costs, then verify the token received.

item.title: Cross-chain business transfers can take minutes or hours
item.description: A cross-chain business transfer may settle in minutes or take hours; the route, liquidity, network confirmations and compliance checks determine when funds arrive.

item.title: How to Estimate Cross-Chain Swap Time
item.description: A cross-chain swap ETA combines source-chain confirmation, bridge processing and destination execution; compare route estimates and track each stage before sending.

item.title: What Cross-Chain Swap Minimum Output Means
item.description: A cross-chain swap minimum output sets the least destination tokens a route may deliver, balancing price movement against execution risk and refund rules.

item.title: Native swap or bridge first? Compare the cross-chain routes
item.description: A native swap can deliver an asset on another chain in one route; bridging first can offer more control when you need a specific token or destination app.

item.title: A Monero bridge swap starts with checking the route
item.description: A Monero bridge can mean a custodial exchange, a wrapped token, or an atomic swap; learn how to check the route, destination asset and refund terms before sending.

item.title: Mantle bridge transfers: four checks before you send
item.description: A Mantle bridge transfer depends on the source network, destination, token, gas balance and address; check each before signing and verify the receipt afterward.

item.title: Aptos launches encrypted mempool on mainnet to limit MEV
item.description: Aptos made its optional encrypted transaction feature live on mainnet Oct. 12, hiding trade details until block ordering is final to limit frontrunning and sandwich attacks.

item.title: Ripple brings Privy wallets to XRP Ledger as payments top 14M
item.description: Ripple and Stripe-owned Privy will bring embedded XRP Ledger wallets to apps as a dashboard reports more than 14.3 million cumulative transactions.

item.title: Sui Foundation commits $30 million to DATA Network migration
item.description: Sui Foundation will invest $30 million in DATA Network as its AI training-data protocol moves to Sui, retiring its chain and migrating its token one-for-one.

item.title: Jeonbuk Bank starts Bitcoin-backed loans for South Korean firms
item.description: Jeonbuk Bank offers won loans backed by Bitcoin to firms, with a custodian holding collateral under South Korea's updated enforcement rules.

item.title: XRP Ledger fixes bug that could have minted 18 trillion XRP
item.description: The XRP Ledger patched a payment bug on Sept. 25 that could have created spendable XRP beyond its 100 billion supply cap in a single transaction.

item.title: Samsung Wallet to add USDC remittances in late October
item.description: Samsung will add USDC transfers to Wallet in late October for eligible users on 82 million U.S. Galaxy devices, with bank payouts available in more than 60 countries.

item.title: Fairshake names 32 House candidates for midterm spending
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for support, including six receiving $1 million each, as the crypto industry turns to midterms after the CLARITY Act stalled.

item.title: ESMA gives EU platforms three months to resolve stablecoin holdings
item.description: ESMA told EU-authorized crypto firms to stop serving stablecoins that fail MiCA rules, while national regulators oversee the resolution of existing customer holdings.
